Guard prototype translate-guard.mjs (a patched copy of phase0/translate.mjs; the repo translator is untouched). Over the 109-case sweep above: shipped translator WRONG 22 / lucky PASS 43 / REFUSED 44; guard REFUSED 109, WRONG 0, PASS 0. COST stated: the 43 lucky PASS cases (e.g. move [0,0,0] then round, move [30,0,0] then hollow(open:top)) are refused too, because a pass there is luck of the nearest-edge snap, not a correct resolve. Sentences a student sees: edge: "Round 1 is not built: it picks the edge by name on a shape that Move 1 moved, and a name cannot be followed through a move or a turn yet -- round the shape first, then move or turn it." | hollow: "Hollow 1 is not built: it picks the face to open by name on a shape that Move 1 moved, and a name cannot be followed through a move or a turn yet -- hollow the shape first, then move or turn it." | after a turn: "Round 1 is not built: it picks the edge by name on a shape that Turn 1 turned, and a name cannot be followed through a move or a turn yet -- round the shape first, then move or turn it." | draft: "Draft 1 is not built: it picks the face by name on a shape that Move 1 moved, and a name cannot be followed through a move or a turn yet -- draft the shape first, then move or turn it.". Expected values are computed from rotation matrices R = Rz*Ry*Rx (X applied first, right-handed, degrees), independent of OCCT/brep-rs. 60 random box turns: truck bbox worst 5.3e-15, COM 2.8e-16. Negative control (i-control.mjs) on turn(box(20,10,6),[30,40,50]): truck bbox matches correct order at 0.0, but the reversed order (z,y,x) would miss by 7.3e-1 and negated angles by 5.5e-2, so the check discriminates order and sign. truck matches live OCCT on all 168 primitive cases (brep-rs too) and the analytic oracle on the 96 matrix cases.

cd docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/move-turn-harness && SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=<pkg built per contract/RIG.md> systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 bun h-param.mjs ; bun e-errors.mjs. move(b,[param('dx',12),param('dy',-3),0]) -> offset [12,-3,0] with sliders move1_x/y/z; runScript(...,{values:{move1_x:40,move1_y:9}}) -> offset [40,9,0] and the pipeline PASSes at dVol 2.3e-16 (planar). turn on a primitive with param angles -> box1_rx/ry/rz sliders; values {box1_rx:75,box1_ry:-20,box1_rz:10} -> rotate [75,-20,10], PASS (dBbox 6.2e-16); cylinder with values {cyl1_rx:65} PASS (dVol 1.7e-4). turn on a derived shape (box+hole) -> turn1_rx/ry/rz sliders; values -> angles [75,-20,10], PASS (dVol 3.6e-6, dBbox 4e-16). Literal-number scripts give an identical doc with no named params. Only caveat: param() on a sphere's turn angle leaves a dead slider.

rows.feature: move() or turn() of a part that join/cut/mirror/repeat already used (fork scripts: the part is consumed in place, OCCT keeps a separate moved shape)
rows.refusalSentence: Move 1 is not built: Box 2 was already used up by Join 1, and this build keeps only one copy of a part, so make the moved or turned copy before Join 1: move(part, [x, y, z], { copy: true }).
rows.evidence: cd docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/move-turn-harness && SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=<pkg built per contract/RIG.md> systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 bun n-fork.mjs  (n-fork-results.json). OCCT builds all of these as two shapes (e.g. join(a,b);move(b,[0,40,0]): op1 vol 1800 bbox [-10,-5,-3,35,5,3] AND move1 vol 600 bbox [25,35,-3,35,45,3]); a SolidCraft command list mutates bodies in place, so the translator marks the consumed part stale and refuses, nothing wrong is built. Refused: join(a,b);move(b), join(a,b);move(a), join(a,b-with-pull);turn(b), cut(a,c);move(c), mirror(v);move(a) (the original after the mirror). Sentences (guard): join(a,b);move(b) -> "Move 1 is not built: Box 2 was already used up by Join 1, and this build keeps only one copy of a part, so make the moved or turned copy before Join 1: move(part, [x, y, z], { copy: true })." | join(a,b);move(a) -> "Move 1 is not built: Box 1 was already used up by Join 1, and this build keeps only one copy of a part, so make the moved or turned copy before Join 1: move(part, [x, y, z], { copy: true })." | join(a,b derived);turn(b) -> "Turn 1 is not built: Move 1 was already used up by Join 1, and this build keeps only one copy of a part, so make the moved or turned copy before Join 1: move(part, [x, y, z], { copy: true })." | cut(a,c);move(c) -> "Move 1 is not built: Cylinder 1 was already used up by Cut 1, and this build keeps only one copy of a part, so make the moved or turned copy before Cut 1: move(part, [x, y, z], { copy: true })." | mirror(v);move(a) -> "Move 1 is not built: Box 1 was already used up by Mirror 1, and this build keeps only one copy of a part, so make the moved or turned copy before Mirror 1: move(part, [x, y, z], { copy: true }).". Shipped developer wording: "move1 (move): its target box2 was already changed in place by op1, and a solidcraft command list has no second copy of it". NOT refused and PASS: mirror(v);move(v) (the move follows the mirrored result), repeat(a);move(a), repeat(a);turn(a), move;move, hole;move. Verified workaround from the sentence: make the copy BEFORE the join: move(b,[0,40,0],{copy:true}); join(a,b) builds the same two shapes as OCCT built for the fork script (n-fork FIX rows: move1 vol 600 bbox [25,35,-3,35,45,3], op1 vol 1800 bbox [-10,-5,-3,35,5,3]; cut and mirror variants PASS 3/3 each body).

rows.feature: move/turn when any coordinate exceeds 3000 mm from the origin (precision limit)
rows.evidence: cd docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/move-turn-harness && SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=<pkg built per contract/RIG.md> systemd-run --user --scope -q -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 bun p-magnitude.mjs ; bun p-magnitude2.mjs ; bun p-magnitude3.mjs  (rerun-p-magnitude*.out). This is a MEASUREMENT-precision limit, not wrong geometry: bbox stays exact (planar dBbox <= 7e-16 and curved dBbox <= 1.1e-6, the tessellation tier, at every distance up to 1e7 mm; a box moved by [1e7,-1e7,5e6] has dVol 1.5e-16), but the volume and centre-of-mass readings degrade, and no sentence is shown. Verified envelope: every coordinate within +-3000 mm passes the planar 1e-9 / curved 3e-4 bars on all shapes tried (box turned at [3000,3000,3000]: dVol=3.7e-11 dBbox=1.5e-16 dCom=5.2e-10; cylinder moved to [3000,3000,3000]: dCom 4.2e-7; hole-box moved and turned at 3000: dCom 5.8e-8). Breakpoints (truck vs OCCT): box centred at [D,D,D] turned [10,20,30]: D=1e4 dVol=1.6e-08 dBbox=1.8e-16 dCom=7.6e-07 (over the 1e-9 planar bar), D=1e5 dVol=6.8e-06 dBbox=1.5e-16 dCom=3.1e-03, D=1e6 dVol=2.8e-03 dBbox=1.2e-16 dCom=1.3e+01; hole-box moved by [D,D,D]: D=3e4 dVol=1.3e-06 dBbox=6.1e-16 dCom=4.5e-04, D=1e6 dVol=6.8e-02 dBbox=5.8e-16 dCom=4.9e+02; sphere moved to 5000: dCom 3.5e-5 (over the 3e-5 curved bar); cylinder moved to 1e4: dCom 4.6e-5, 1e5: dCom 0.68 x diagonal and dVol 7.8e-4, 1e6: dVol 0.60. Not affected: join of two parts at 1e6 (dVol 0, dCom 2.8e-12), plain box move at any distance. brep-rs stays within 2.1e-7 everywhere, so the loss is in the SolidCraft mass-property path. Recommendation: document +-3000 mm as the supported working volume; if the studio shows mass properties, refuse (with a sentence) or warn beyond it rather than show the degraded number.

rows.feature: move() argument misuse the interpreter silently accepts: an extra argument after the options, copy:"yes" or copy:1
rows.evidence: cd docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/move-turn-harness && SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=<pkg built per contract/RIG.md> bun q-interp.mjs  (interpreter only). move(b,[1,2,3],{copy:true},4) raises NO error and builds move1(copy) [1,2,3] (the 4 is dropped); turn(b,[1,2,3],4) IS refused ("turn() takes a shape and a list of angles; the third argument (4) was ignored."); move(b,[1,2,3],4) is refused ("move's extras go in a { } object at the end, like move(..., { copy: ... }). You gave it 4."). move(b,[1,2,3],{copy:"yes"}) and {copy:1} build a plain CONSUMING move with no sentence (the student asked for a copy and the original is gone). Both builds agree with OCCT (the kernels are not involved), so these are interpreter silent-accept gaps in packages/script (read-only here): no refusal sentence exists today. Properly refused with plain sentences: unknown option ("move has no option called \"keep\". It takes copy."), 2 numbers, 2 angles, text angle, NaN, move/turn of a sketch or plane, move with no shape. turn(sphere) is an accepted no-op (sphere row).
